body: Found 2026-10-18 by the V1-1585 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1104, head 2215d54aa, PSR-V0-160..167); recorded in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-v1-1585-pool-member-lifecycle.md. title: pool operate: a passed reset/retarget from QUARANTINED needs an explicit confirm-safe to return to FREE
